title: The batch runner refuses a lane whose lint is red at its head
why: A lane joined a batch with red local lint (PR #979). Source: owner-feedback audit, claude-settings draft PR #1008 (docs/plans/owner-feedback-audit.md, section 6), Nov 1 20:06 CST.
note: The batch runner runs the lane's local lint at its head and refuses the lane if red. Red first: replay #979. Ready. Port: yes, shared.
